name: BODYCAM: SWAT Simulator
desc:
👮‍♂️ BODYCAM is a police response simulator where you play as a SWAT officer and complete missions with your team across different locations.
👥 Play with friends, work together as a squad, complete objectives, and unlock new equipment.

👍 NEXT UPDATE AT 130K LIKES 👍
⭐ Like, Favorite the game, and join the group for more updates ⭐

🕹️ SWAT Simulator is playable on following devices:

🖥️ PC/Laptop
📱 Mobile
🎮 Console

🎛️ PC/CONSOLE CONTROLS:

Left Shift / R1 - Sprint
Square - Interact
V / Square - Flashlight
Z / Triangle - Lazer
X - Change Firemode
CTRL / L1 - Crouch
Q / DPadLeft - Lean to the Left
E / DPadRight - Lean to the Right
M - Check your Magazine
1,2,3,4 / DPadUp - Change Equipment (Rifle, Secondary, Flashbang)
Inspect Weapon / Check Ammo - M
